description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Comparison of Material Model Calibration Methods Using Response Predictions from Component Model is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sanjay Govindjee, University of California Berkeley (berkeley.edu). This project employed three different methods of material model calibration and evaluated these methods based on the accuracy of the predictions from a structural component model that incorporated these calibrated material models. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-gprd-ph26. Keywords: NHERI SimCenter, Seismic Structural Response, Bayesian Calibration, Steel02 Material Model, Model Uncertainty. Published 2022-08-24. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
